items.title: 15.4 How to check the purity of the product (product kitna pure hai, kaise jaanchein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.4 with the aspirin scheme and Quick Check 15.5, printed pages 332-333.

blocks.text: Jo compounds aam conditions mein liquid ya solid hon, unhen saaf (purify) karne ke alag alag tareeqe hain. Liquids aam taur par normal pressure par ya vacuum mein distil kar ke saaf kiye jate hain. Liquid ki purity us ke boiling point ko literature (kitabon) mein likhe boiling point se mila kar jaanchi jati hai.

Aspirin banane ke liye salicylic acid ko excess (zyada) acetic anhydride se react karaya jata hai, saath concentrated H₂SO₄ ke chand qatre dale jate hain. Aspirin bohat important analgesic (dard kam karne wali) aur antipyretic (bukhar utarne wali) dawa hai.

Reaction khatam hone ke baad mixture mein pani dala jata hai taake aspirin solid ban kar neeche beth jaye (precipitate ho). Phir mixture filter kar ke crude (kachchi) aspirin milti hai. Phir ise polar solvent ke taur par pani mein crystallize kiya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki drawing: salicylic acid (benzene ring par paas paas COOH aur OH) (CH3CO)2O ke saath, H2SO4 aur garmi mein, acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) banata hai jis mein OH ki jagah O-C(=O)-CH3 aa jata hai.
blocks.caption: Salicylic acid se aspirin banana (kitab mein chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal hissa woh acetyl group hai jo acetic anhydride se salicylic acid ke OH par lagta hai (esterification). Baqi molecule, ring aur COOH, waisa hi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki scheme mein catalyst 'H3PO)4' (yani H₃PO₄) chhapa hai, jabke kitab ka text concentrated H₂SO₄ kehta hai. Hum ne text ke mutabiq H₂SO₄ likha hai. 'AcetylSalicylic' ko bhi 'Acetylsalicylic' likha hai.

items: Is tarah bani aspirin mein bacha hua salicylic acid (jo react nahi hua) mila ho sakta hai. Product pure hai ya impure, yeh dekhne ke liye us ka melting point maloom kiya jata hai. Agar product ek dum (sharply) theek 136°C par pighle to woh pure mana jata hai. Agar woh ek temperature par nahi balkay temperature ki range mein pighle to woh impure hai.

Purity jaanchne ka doosra tareeqa mixed melting point hai. Is mein product ko pure aspirin ke sample ke saath mila kar melting point dekha jata hai. Agar ab bhi melting point sharp rahe to product pure hai.
Teesra tareeqa yeh hai ke is sample ki paper chromatography pure aspirin aur pure salicylic acid ke samples ke saath ki jaye aur Rf value milayi jaye.

blocks.prompt: a) Kisi substance ka melting point us ki purity kaise batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Pure crystalline solid ek fixed temperature par ek dum (sharply) pighalta hai. Impurities melting point ko kam kar deti hain aur substance ek range mein pighalta hai. Is liye sharp aur kitab wala melting point = pure; range mein pighalna = impure.

blocks.prompt: b) Kaun si technique (filtration, crystallization ya distillation) in mixtures ke liye suitable hai? (i) petroleum aur pani (ii) NaCl aur NaNO₃ (iii) activated charcoal aur sodium chloride (iv) methanol, ethanol aur propanol
blocks.explanation: (i) Petroleum aur pani aapas mein nahi milte; inhen distillation se (ya separating funnel se) alag kiya ja sakta hai. (ii) Dono pani mein hal hone wale solids hain jin ki solubility alag hai: crystallization. (iii) Namak pani mein hal karein, charcoal hal nahi hota: filtration, phir filtrate se namak ki crystallization. (iv) Teeno miscible liquids hain jin ke boiling points alag hain: fractional distillation.

blocks.prompt: Aap glucosazone ke lab sample ki purity kaise check karenge?
blocks.explanation: Sample ko crystallize karein, us ka melting point le kar kitab ki value se milayein, pure sample ke saath mixed melting point lein ke woh sharp rahe, aur pure glucosazone ke saath paper chromatogram chalayein ke ek hi Rf ka akela spot aaye.

items: Liquids: distil karein, boiling point milayein.

Solids (salicylic acid + acetic anhydride, concentrated H₂SO₄ ke saath = aspirin): 136°C par sharp melting point, sharp mixed melting point, ya pure aspirin aur salicylic acid ke saath chromatography mein Rf milana.
